hooks.command: M="${CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR:-${CLAUDE_PROJECT_ROOT:-$HOME/mnt}}"; O="outputs"; [ -d "$M/output" ] && O="output"; D="${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_DATA:-$M/$O}/probe-results/hooks"; mkdir -p "$D"; TS=$(date -u +%Y-%m-%dT%H%M%SZ); printf 'hook=PostToolUse tool=%s fired_at=%s\n' "${CLAUDE_TOOL_NAME:-}" "$TS" >> "$D/${TS}-post-tool-use.txt"
